data.description: Spacious Layout | Prime Location | Investor's Deal
data.display_address: Sobha Creek Vista Heights, sobha_hartland, Mohammed Bin Rashid City, Dubai
data.long_description:
Sobha Hartland is a prestigious residential community that encompasses an exceptional range of luxurious duplexes, villas, apartments, and townhouses. Spanning across nearly 8 million square feet of prime land, this renowned development is located in the heart of Mohammed Bin Rashid City, one of Dubai’s most sought-after locations.

These apartments offer a sophisticated living experience, featuring three spacious bedrooms, including two en-suite bathrooms, designed for maximum comfort and privacy. The generous layout is further enhanced by a large balcony area, providing a perfect spot to enjoy the surrounding views.

As a resident, you’ll have access to world-class amenities, including a communal swimming pool and a fully equipped gym, offering a lifestyle of convenience and relaxation right at your doorstep. Whether you're taking a refreshing dip or maintaining your fitness, these facilities are designed to cater to your every need.

Sobha Hartland doesn’t just offer a place to live – it’s an experience that transcends the ordinary. The development blends unparalleled luxury with a vibrant lifestyle, offering a harmonious balance between modern living and lush green spaces. This makes it an ideal choice not only for those seeking a dream home but also for investors looking for a property in one of Dubai’s most coveted communities. With its combination of top-tier amenities, spacious living spaces, and prime location, Sobha Hartland provides an exceptional quality of life for those who call it home.
